statut: référence de travail ; direction D retenue par le responsable le 2026-10-19 (« Je retiens la direction D : décor encré comme une illustration de carte, avec les couleurs des quatre familles. »)
usage: référence de conception de la direction artistique du décor de la ville (M09 V3), jamais dans le jeu ni dans le build
remarque: l'image emploie des enseignes du jeu de cartes classique (pique, trèfle) : dans le jeu, ce sont les emblèmes des quatre familles (src/art/emblems.ts) qui les remplacent

images.prompt:
Concept art in a FRONTAL 2.5D side-on view with a gentle 8-degree downward tilt (the camera faces the building fronts like a stage seen from the stalls; NOT top-down, NOT isometric): a night harbour quay in a port city where people challenge each other to card duels. Bottom of the image: dark water with long lantern reflections and two moored boats with masts and rigging. Then the stone quay wall with iron mooring rings and a small water stair. Middle: a wet cobbled quay street where a small chibi-proportioned hooded card duellist in a long coat walks, a market stall with an ivory canvas awning and a cluster of hanging lanterns, iron lamp posts. Behind: a row of varied facades: a stone card hall with four tall family banners and arched doors, a narrow half-timbered house with its gable facing the street, the Fanal tavern with a wooden balcony, an open glowing door and a hanging lantern sign, a shipowner's house; slate roofs, chimneys, dormers. Far behind: an upper town climbing a hill with a cathedral, and a low moon. Four card families: Ember (orange embers), Veil (blue and silver), Bramble (green thorns), Star (gold stars). No readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no modern objects.

Art style: the inked illustration of a collectible playing card combined with the colour identity of the four card families: hand-inked contour lines on every edge, flat colour shapes with one or two shading bands, fine hatching in the shadows, a subtle paper grain; deep ink-blue night; each family brings its jewel colour to lights and glass (ember-orange braziers and lanterns at the tavern, bramble-green lamps at the stall, a blue-silver Veil moonlight on the hill town, star-gold gilding on emblems, sign frames and ironwork); softly glowing card-suit glyphs on the quay wall and lamp posts; stained glass with the family emblems in the card hall. Graphic, elegant, readable, theatrical.
